answers.Q1_broken_symmetry: none: 0/48 M1 points meet any of the 3 pre-registered criteria; one-lobe starts re-symmetrise in median 1.0-7.0 model time
answers.Q1_first_order_lines: none found: loop areas fall 3.6-15.5x from D = 50 to 800 toward the noise floor (3-point slopes -0.46 to -0.99 are descriptive, not exponents); at D = 800 r = 0 (permutation p < 0.001) and r = 0.5 (p = 0.02), h = 1e-5, are still open but still shrinking; no coexistence at any of 14 M2b loop centres (only 2 of them at the onset); one non-silent attractor in all 23 surviving M3 cells; no coexistence in 40 QMF multistable cells (M3b)
answers.Q2e_onset_first_order: no first-order signature: no coexistence, no hysteresis that persists with dwell; argues against first order within detection limits, does not distinguish a rounded second-order transition from a smooth rare-region crossover. h = 0 down-sweeps die near tau = D (consistency with the lifetime map, not a discriminating test; observed extinction g is ~0.6-1 grid step below the prediction at all 6 r, sign test p = 0.031)
answers.strength: strong against broken L/R symmetry and against coexistence within B = 32-64, D <= 800, T <= 5000; moderate for the onset itself (M2b thin there); cannot exclude sub-noise-floor hysteresis or metastability living > 5000

'no hysteresis beyond noise' -> 'none that persists with dwell': permutation test finds r = 0 (p < 0.001) and r = 0.5 (p = 0.02), h = 1e-5, still open at D = 800, both still shrinking
